grading.unsupported_claims: List every added assertion that is not entailed by the source. An empty list means none found.

clarity.0: Unclear, malformed, or harder to use than source.
clarity.1: Clear and usable but awkward phrasing or unnecessary repetition remains.

grading.editing_goal_met: Boolean semantic judgment against each predeclared case goal. Identity outputs can meet the clear controls, and cannot meet cases requiring a real edit.
grading.review_required: Human or model-assisted semantic review must judge every claim and provide evidence for all failures. Mechanical text-overlap is descriptive only.

order: fewest contradicted plus omitted plus uncertain claims plus unsupported assertions
ranking.fully_acceptable: Every source claim preserved, zero unsupported assertions, clarity at least 1, editing goal met, generation successful.
ranking.ties: Declare ties when all ranking fields match. Do not use detector readings to break ties.
ranking.uncertainty: Eight recipes on eight cases measure this fixed sample. Distinguishing training randomness requires repeated seeds of the same recipe. Greedy output reruns measure inference repeatability, not training variance.
